 end Coproduct
 
+/-! ## §8. Transport along translated open components
+
+For a group scheme, point translations are automorphisms over the base. The
+constructions below are stated for an arbitrary automorphism in `Over S`: the
+image of an open component is again an open component, isomorphic over `S` to
+the original one. Consequently a specified relatively very ample line bundle
+transports to every translated component, and §7 assembles the resulting
+family into the two geometric side conditions needed by the Picard seam.
+
+This is the translation substrate only. Applying it to `Pic^d` still requires
+an intrinsic degree-piece carrier and a family of translations that identifies
+those pieces with the chosen component; no representability hypothesis is
+introduced here.
+-/
+
+namespace Opens
+
+/-- Regard an open subscheme of an object `G : Over S` as an object over the
+same base. -/
+noncomputable def toOver {S : Scheme.{u}} (G : Over S) (U : G.left.Opens) : Over S :=
+  Over.mk (U.ι ≫ G.hom)
+
+/-- An automorphism of a scheme identifies an open subscheme with its open
+image. -/
+noncomputable def imageIso {X : Scheme.{u}} (e : X ≅ X) (U : X.Opens) :
+    U.toScheme ≅ (e.hom ''ᵁ U).toScheme :=
+  IsOpenImmersion.isoOfRangeEq (U.ι ≫ e.hom) (e.hom ''ᵁ U).ι (by
+    change ((U.ι ≫ e.hom).opensRange : Set X) =
+      ((e.hom ''ᵁ U).ι.opensRange : Set X)
+    rw [Scheme.Hom.opensRange_comp, Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι,
+      Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι])
+
+/-- The open image of `U` under an automorphism of `G` over `S`, with its
+inherited structure morphism to `S`. -/
+noncomputable def imageOver {S : Scheme.{u}} {G : Over S} (e : G ≅ G)
+    (U : G.left.Opens) : Over S :=
+  toOver G (e.hom.left ''ᵁ U)
+
+/-- The open-image isomorphism, promoted to an isomorphism over the base. -/
+noncomputable def imageOverIso {S : Scheme.{u}} {G : Over S} (e : G ≅ G)
+    (U : G.left.Opens) :
+    toOver G U ≅ imageOver e U :=
+  Over.isoMk (imageIso ((Over.forget S).mapIso e) U) (by
+    have hfac : (imageIso ((Over.forget S).mapIso e) U).hom ≫
+        (e.hom.left ''ᵁ U).ι = U.ι ≫ e.hom.left := by
+      exact IsOpenImmersion.isoOfRangeEq_hom_fac
+        (U.ι ≫ e.hom.left) (e.hom.left ''ᵁ U).ι _
+    have hew : e.hom.left ≫ G.hom = G.hom := Over.w e.hom
+    change (imageIso ((Over.forget S).mapIso e) U).hom ≫
+      ((e.hom.left ''ᵁ U).ι ≫ G.hom) = U.ι ≫ G.hom
+    calc
+      _ = ((imageIso ((Over.forget S).mapIso e) U).hom ≫
+          (e.hom.left ''ᵁ U).ι) ≫ G.hom := (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
+      _ = (U.ι ≫ e.hom.left) ≫ G.hom :=
+        congrArg (fun f => f ≫ G.hom) hfac
+      _ = U.ι ≫ (e.hom.left ≫ G.hom) := Category.assoc _ _ _
+      _ = U.ι ≫ G.hom := congrArg (fun f => U.ι ≫ f) hew)
+
+end Opens
+
+namespace Hom.IsHQuasiProjectiveWith
+
+/-- A relatively very ample line bundle on an open component transports to
+its image under any automorphism over the base. -/
+theorem imageOver {S : Scheme.{0}} {G : Over S} {U : G.left.Opens}
+    {L : (Opens.toOver G U).left.Modules}
+    (h : (Opens.toOver G U).hom.IsHQuasiProjectiveWith L) (e : G ≅ G) :
+    (Opens.imageOver e U).hom.IsHQuasiProjectiveWith
+      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (Opens.imageOverIso e U).inv.left).obj L) := by
+  simpa using h.of_over_iso (Opens.imageOverIso e U).symm
+
+end Hom.IsHQuasiProjectiveWith
+
+/-- A family of translated copies of one H-quasi-projective open component
+carries the transported relatively very ample line bundles. Its canonical
+coproduct is locally of finite type and satisfies `FiniteInAffine`.
+
+For pointed Picard schemes the intended automorphisms are tensor translations
+by degree representatives. The theorem deliberately leaves construction of
+those representatives and identification of the degree pieces to the Picard
+producer. -/
+theorem isHQuasiProjectiveWith_and_locallyOfFiniteType_and_finiteInAffine_sigma_imageOver
+    {σ : Type v} [Small.{0, v} σ] {S : Scheme.{0}} [IsAffine S]
+    (G : Over S) (U : G.left.Opens)
+    {L : (Opens.toOver G U).left.Modules}
+    (h : (Opens.toOver G U).hom.IsHQuasiProjectiveWith L)
+    (e : σ → (G ≅ G)) :
+    let X : σ → Over S := fun i => Opens.imageOver (e i) U
+    let L' : ∀ i, (X i).left.Modules := fun i =>
+      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (Opens.imageOverIso (e i) U).inv.left).obj L
+    (∀ i, (X i).hom.IsHQuasiProjectiveWith (L' i)) ∧
+      LocallyOfFiniteType (∐ X).hom ∧ FiniteInAffine (∐ X).left := by
+  let X : σ → Over S := fun i => Opens.imageOver (e i) U
+  let L' : ∀ i, (X i).left.Modules := fun i =>
+    (Scheme.Modules.pullback (Opens.imageOverIso (e i) U).inv.left).obj L
+  have hX : ∀ i, (X i).hom.IsHQuasiProjectiveWith (L' i) :=
+    fun i => h.imageOver (e i)
+  exact ⟨hX,
+    locallyOfFiniteType_and_finiteInAffine_sigma_of_isHQuasiProjectiveWith X L' hX⟩
+
 end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme

     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.CechKernelLemma
     7	
     8	/-!
     9	# Restriction of relative Picard classes to an étale cover is injective
    10	
    11	The usable form of the (C1) étale-separatedness theorem
    12	(`AlgebraicGeometry.PicEtAff.unit_injective`, `AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.CechKernelLemma`)
    13	for the Layer-2 gluing arguments: for a curve `C` (proper, geometrically irreducible and
    14	geometrically reduced over `k`), a `k`-algebra `R` and a presented étale cover `E` of
    15	`Spec R`, two relative Picard classes over `R` with equal restrictions to the cover
    16	carrier are equal (`AlgebraicGeometry.relPicAlgMap_injective_of_etaleCover`).
    17	
    18	Indeed, the unit of the plus construction sends a class `z` to its tautological descent
    19	class represented on *any* cover (`PicEtAff.unit_eq_mk`), so equal restrictions give
    20	equal units, and the unit is injective by (C1).
    21	-/
    22	
    23	set_option autoImplicit false
    24	
    25	universe u
    26	
    27	open CategoryTheory
    28	
    29	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    30	
    31	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    32	variable {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
    33	
    34	/-- The composite `R → Γ(self cover) → Γ(E)` of the tautological identifications is the
    35	structure map of the carrier of `E`. -/
    36	private lemma fromSelf_comp_ofId (E : Algebra.EtaleCover R) :
    37	    (E.fromSelf.restrictScalars k).comp
    38	        ((Algebra.ofId R (Algebra.EtaleCover.self R).Carrier).restrictScalars k)
    39	      = (Algebra.ofId R E.Carrier).restrictScalars k := by
    40	  ext r
    41	  simp only [AlgHom.coe_comp, AlgHom.coe_restrictScalars', Function.comp_apply,
    42	    Algebra.ofId_apply, Algebra.EtaleCover.fromSelf, AlgHom.coe_comp]
    43	  exact congrArg (algebraMap R E.Carrier)
    44	    (((Algebra.EtaleCover.selfEquiv R).commutes r).trans rfl)
    45	
    46	/-- The unit of the plus construction, represented on an arbitrary cover: `unit z` is the
    47	class of the tautological descent datum of `z` on any presented étale cover `E`. -/
    48	theorem PicEtAff.unit_eq_mk (E : Algebra.EtaleCover R) (z : relPic C (overSpec k R)) :
    49	    PicEtAff.unit C R z
    50	      = PicEtAff.mk C E
    51	          ⟨relPicAlgMap C ((Algebra.ofId R E.Carrier).restrictScalars k) z,
    52	            tautological_mem_descentClasses C E z⟩ := by
    53	  have hval : descentMap C E.fromSelf
    54	        ⟨relPicAlgMap C
    55	            ((Algebra.ofId R (Algebra.EtaleCover.self R).Carrier).restrictScalars k) z,
    56	          tautological_mem_descentClasses C (.self R) z⟩
    57	      = ⟨relPicAlgMap C ((Algebra.ofId R E.Carrier).restrictScalars k) z,
    58	          tautological_mem_descentClasses C E z⟩ := by
    59	    refine Subtype.ext ?_
    60	    rw [descentMap_coe, ← relPicAlgMap_comp, fromSelf_comp_ofId]
    61	  calc PicEtAff.unit C R z
    62	      = PicEtAff.mk C (.self R)
    63	          ⟨relPicAlgMap C
    64	              ((Algebra.ofId R (Algebra.EtaleCover.self R).Carrier).restrictScalars k) z,
    65	            tautological_mem_descentClasses C (.self R) z⟩ := rfl
    66	    _ = PicEtAff.mk C E (descentMap C E.fromSelf
    67	          ⟨relPicAlgMap C
    68	              ((Algebra.ofId R (Algebra.EtaleCover.self R).Carrier).restrictScalars k) z,
    69	            tautological_mem_descentClasses C (.self R) z⟩) :=
    70	        (PicEtAff.mk_descentMap C E.fromSelf _).symm
    71	    _ = PicEtAff.mk C E
    72	          ⟨relPicAlgMap C ((Algebra.ofId R E.Carrier).restrictScalars k) z,
    73	            tautological_mem_descentClasses C E z⟩ := by rw [hval]
    74	
    75	variable [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] [GeometricallyReduced C.hom]
    76	
    77	/-- **Restriction of relative Picard classes to an étale cover is injective** — the
    78	consumable corollary of the (C1) étale-separatedness theorem: two relative Picard
    79	classes over `R` agreeing on a presented étale cover of `Spec R` agree.  This is what
    80	licenses every gluing step of the Layer-2 functor. -/
    81	theorem relPicAlgMap_injective_of_etaleCover (E : Algebra.EtaleCover R) :
    82	    Function.Injective
    83	      (relPicAlgMap C ((Algebra.ofId R E.Carrier).restrictScalars k)) := by
    84	  intro x y h
    85	  apply PicEtAff.unit_injective C R
    86	  rw [PicEtAff.unit_eq_mk C E x, PicEtAff.unit_eq_mk C E y]
    87	  exact congrArg (PicEtAff.mk C E) (Subtype.ext h)
    88	
    89	end AlgebraicGeometry

@@ -967,4 +967,104 @@ theorem finiteInAffine_coprod {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (hX : FiniteInAffine X)
 
 end Coproduct
 
+/-! ## §8. Transport along translated open components
+
+For a group scheme, point translations are automorphisms over the base. The
+constructions below are stated for an arbitrary automorphism in `Over S`: the
+image of an open component is again an open component, isomorphic over `S` to
+the original one. Consequently a specified relatively very ample line bundle
+transports to every translated component, and §7 assembles the resulting
+family into the two geometric side conditions needed by the Picard seam.
+
+This is the translation substrate only. Applying it to `Pic^d` still requires
+an intrinsic degree-piece carrier and a family of translations that identifies
+those pieces with the chosen component; no representability hypothesis is
+introduced here.
+-/
+
+namespace Opens
+
+/-- Regard an open subscheme of an object `G : Over S` as an object over the
+same base. -/
+noncomputable def toOver {S : Scheme.{u}} (G : Over S) (U : G.left.Opens) : Over S :=
+  Over.mk (U.ι ≫ G.hom)
+
+/-- An automorphism of a scheme identifies an open subscheme with its open
+image. -/
+noncomputable def imageIso {X : Scheme.{u}} (e : X ≅ X) (U : X.Opens) :
+    U.toScheme ≅ (e.hom ''ᵁ U).toScheme :=
+  IsOpenImmersion.isoOfRangeEq (U.ι ≫ e.hom) (e.hom ''ᵁ U).ι (by
+    change ((U.ι ≫ e.hom).opensRange : Set X) =
+      ((e.hom ''ᵁ U).ι.opensRange : Set X)
+    rw [Scheme.Hom.opensRange_comp, Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι,
+      Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι])
+
+/-- The open image of `U` under an automorphism of `G` over `S`, with its
+inherited structure morphism to `S`. -/
+noncomputable def imageOver {S : Scheme.{u}} {G : Over S} (e : G ≅ G)
+    (U : G.left.Opens) : Over S :=
+  toOver G (e.hom.left ''ᵁ U)
+
+/-- The open-image isomorphism, promoted to an isomorphism over the base. -/
+noncomputable def imageOverIso {S : Scheme.{u}} {G : Over S} (e : G ≅ G)
+    (U : G.left.Opens) :
+    toOver G U ≅ imageOver e U :=
+  Over.isoMk (imageIso ((Over.forget S).mapIso e) U) (by
+    have hfac : (imageIso ((Over.forget S).mapIso e) U).hom ≫
+        (e.hom.left ''ᵁ U).ι = U.ι ≫ e.hom.left := by
+      exact IsOpenImmersion.isoOfRangeEq_hom_fac
+        (U.ι ≫ e.hom.left) (e.hom.left ''ᵁ U).ι _
+    have hew : e.hom.left ≫ G.hom = G.hom := Over.w e.hom
+    change (imageIso ((Over.forget S).mapIso e) U).hom ≫
+      ((e.hom.left ''ᵁ U).ι ≫ G.hom) = U.ι ≫ G.hom
+    calc
+      _ = ((imageIso ((Over.forget S).mapIso e) U).hom ≫
+          (e.hom.left ''ᵁ U).ι) ≫ G.hom := (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
+      _ = (U.ι ≫ e.hom.left) ≫ G.hom :=
+        congrArg (fun f => f ≫ G.hom) hfac
+      _ = U.ι ≫ (e.hom.left ≫ G.hom) := Category.assoc _ _ _
+      _ = U.ι ≫ G.hom := congrArg (fun f => U.ι ≫ f) hew)
+
+end Opens
+
+namespace Hom.IsHQuasiProjectiveWith
+
+/-- A relatively very ample line bundle on an open component transports to
+its image under any automorphism over the base. -/
+theorem imageOver {S : Scheme.{0}} {G : Over S} {U : G.left.Opens}
+    {L : (Opens.toOver G U).left.Modules}
+    (h : (Opens.toOver G U).hom.IsHQuasiProjectiveWith L) (e : G ≅ G) :
+    (Opens.imageOver e U).hom.IsHQuasiProjectiveWith
+      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (Opens.imageOverIso e U).inv.left).obj L) := by
+  simpa using h.of_over_iso (Opens.imageOverIso e U).symm
+
+end Hom.IsHQuasiProjectiveWith
+
+/-- A family of translated copies of one H-quasi-projective open component
+carries the transported relatively very ample line bundles. Its canonical
+coproduct is locally of finite type and satisfies `FiniteInAffine`.
+
+For pointed Picard schemes the intended automorphisms are tensor translations
+by degree representatives. The theorem deliberately leaves construction of
+those representatives and identification of the degree pieces to the Picard
+producer. -/
+theorem isHQuasiProjectiveWith_and_locallyOfFiniteType_and_finiteInAffine_sigma_imageOver
+    {σ : Type v} [Small.{0, v} σ] {S : Scheme.{0}} [IsAffine S]
+    (G : Over S) (U : G.left.Opens)
+    {L : (Opens.toOver G U).left.Modules}
+    (h : (Opens.toOver G U).hom.IsHQuasiProjectiveWith L)
+    (e : σ → (G ≅ G)) :
+    let X : σ → Over S := fun i => Opens.imageOver (e i) U
+    let L' : ∀ i, (X i).left.Modules := fun i =>
+      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (Opens.imageOverIso (e i) U).inv.left).obj L
+    (∀ i, (X i).hom.IsHQuasiProjectiveWith (L' i)) ∧
+      LocallyOfFiniteType (∐ X).hom ∧ FiniteInAffine (∐ X).left := by
+  let X : σ → Over S := fun i => Opens.imageOver (e i) U
+  let L' : ∀ i, (X i).left.Modules := fun i =>
+    (Scheme.Modules.pullback (Opens.imageOverIso (e i) U).inv.left).obj L
+  have hX : ∀ i, (X i).hom.IsHQuasiProjectiveWith (L' i) :=
+    fun i => h.imageOver (e i)
+  exact ⟨hX,
+    locallyOfFiniteType_and_finiteInAffine_sigma_of_isHQuasiProjectiveWith X L' hX⟩
+
 end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme
